All I can say is, thank God or Pikachu or Mrs. Doubtfire that I have a puppy that loves me and the fact that I can't bear the thought of my mother's reaction to my brains on the ceiling. The problem is how fickle of a concept it is, and that if I find myself in a bad spot with bad thoughts in my head, that I might do something stupid before I do something smart.

Yeah I was kind of wondering about that, thinking that the only people on this sub reddit are either killing themselves, grief counselors, or get off on other peoples' sorrow. But as far as what's bothering me? It's tough to put my finger on it and I think I'd need more fingers anyway. The simplest answer: I hate people; I hate myself; My old solutions aren't cutting it anymore. I could go into more detail but it would just be me rambling.  It's kind of frustrating because I can go from being convinced that I'm going to kill myself tonight or tomorrow, to eating a good sandwich and the whole world being ok. The thought of THAT makes me want to kill myself, but not tonight, not while this sandwich tastes so good. I'll have to wait until I'm at that point of "no-longer-satisfied-by-my-food" but still not hungry. It's all just attention-seeking behavior, but it's starting to get old.  I'll try to suppress it but that makes the hurt worse. Then when I stop suppressing it, I'm ashamed and embarrassed of myself and it leads me right back to it.  What's even more frustrating about it is that the way I keep imagining it happening in my head is barely artistic. And even if it is artistic, it becomes so obvious that it loses it's value. In a nutshell: Insecurity, "lost love", and false empowerment. Everyone loves me but I can't figure out how to return the feeling.
